terms.gloss: nourishing, cherishing; hence kind, propitious, bountiful: the poets’ epithet of Ceres, Venus, the earth, the light

phrases.latin: Euandrum ex humilī tēctō lūx suscitat alma et mātūtīnī volucrum sub culmine cantūs
phrases.english: the kindly light wakes Evander in his humble house, and the morning songs of the birds under the roof

sources: Lewis & Short: almus
